title: GTA-Inspired PS5 Open World Goes Full Tycoon in Upcoming Update
summary: Manage city logistics in new mode

Manage Topics News Perfect World PS5 NTE Updates GTA-Inspired PS5 Open World Goes Full Tycoon in Upcoming Update Manage city logistics in new mode by Sammy Barker 9 hours ago Share: Image: Push Square The real GTA 6 may be right around the corner, but Hotta Studio’s anime-inspired open world NTE is getting a big update on 11th November to keep you occupied in the meantime. And as has become customary for Heathereau, there’s a lot to look forward to here, including two new characters, story quests, and more. But watching through the preview livestream last night , the thing that jumped out to me is the new City Logistics management minigame. In the current version of NTE you can take on delivery jobs all around the open world. But in v1.5 you’ll be able to recruit staff and assign them work which will transform this aspect of the game into more of a tycoon management experience. Regular readers will know I love when my open world has a side helping of business sim, so I’m really looking forward to sinking my teeth into this. Other new activities include an in-game board game you can buy, which adds some tycoon-themed puzzles to the title. And there’s a new tank vehicle you can take online in a competitive deathmatch-style minigame. This update will run through 23rd December so you’ll have plenty of time to catch up on its activities alongside GTA 6. I’m really looking forward to getting to grips with the new business activities.
